pull.title: doc: release note about I2P ElGamal sunset

events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### Code Coverage & Benchmarks For details see: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/35951. ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | Stale ACK | [janb84](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35951#pullrequestreview-4918079648), [zzzi2p](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35951#issuecomment-5269860999) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore.

Concept ACK 732a87badfb2429f593d1bbd3e7ae90211a8781d

Given the recommendation of (one of the) i2p maintainers about sunsetting the usage of ElGamal, I think this is a good step into doing that. 

But because of the low possible nodes affected (According to https://coin.dance/nodes there are currently 26545 nodes, of those nodes there are roughly 2514 nodes (<26.1) So ~10% of the nodes are affected, I do not have any I2P usage-data but given the popularity of i2p that is only a small subset of those 2514 nodes.)

I would suggest to even expedite the timeline to version v33

> I would suggest to even expedite the timeline to version v33

(IIUC, there is no rush here, as https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35696 islands legacy I2P peers in favor of quantum-resistant signatures, which bitcoin in general is not ready for yet. The urgency is for pre-v26.1 users of I2P (good catch, thank you) to upgrade.

ACK 558cf9f

not expressing an opinion on the choice of release target, as I said in the other PR that's up to you folks.

comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+### P2P and Network Changes
+
+Support for the legacy ElGamal (type 0) encryption type when creating I2P
+sessions is being sunset by the I2P network and will be removed from bitcoind
+on or before v34. Nodes using I2P with versions of Bitcoin Core earlier than v27
+(PR #29200) should upgrade to at least v27, as they will soon only be able
comments.body: Why not the latest release, or one of the maintained branches? When v32 will be released, v27 will have been EOL for a year, and has multiple published CVEs.

comments.body: Thanks, but I'm still not sure why we would mention these older versions? Saying `must upgrade to at least 26.1` implies that we think it would still be safe/ok for a user to upgrade to `26.1`, but I don't think it is? We only recommend users run the latest/actively maintained versions of our software, and in this case, 26.1 is known to be unsafe.
